display_name: GraniteShares 2x Long SK Hynix Daily ETF bStock

about.en: GraniteShares 2x Long SK Hynix Daily ETF bStock (SKUUB) is a tokenized fund share of the GraniteShares 2x Long SK Hynix Daily ETF issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x97e8cfe35467d7ad6ed672d519e466200fb394d0, backed 1:1 by SKUU fund shares held with a regulated custodian and convertible 1:1 into the underlying fund share, so it inherits the daily-reset 2x leverage and roll costs of the ETF itself. bStocks are admitted to trading under prospectuses approved by the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority and are not offered in every jurisdiction.
